metaTitle: Deep Cleaning in Pasadena, CA | Tarea
metaDescription: Deep cleaning for Pasadena homes, from Craftsman bungalows to Spanish-revival details. Flat-rate pricing, $200 to $365.
intro: If your Pasadena home hasn't had a real deep clean in a while, the original wood floors, tile counters, and built-in cabinetry common in Craftsman and Spanish-revival houses tend to show it fast. Dust settles into crown molding and window trim, and grease can build up in kitchens that still have their original tile backsplashes. A deep clean gets past the surface-level tidying to address all of that at once.
causes: Original wood floors and baseboards in older Craftsman homes collect dust and grime in ways that regular sweeping doesn't catch.
Window units or older HVAC systems, common in these homes, circulate more dust than central air, leaving film on sills and blinds.
Spanish-revival kitchens and bathrooms often have decorative tile with grout lines that trap dirt over time.
Built-in shelving, nooks, and window seats create extra surfaces that get skipped during routine cleaning.
Infrequent cleaning behind furniture and appliances lets dust and grease accumulate unnoticed for months.
whatProDoes: Dust and wipe down ceiling fixtures, crown molding, window trim, and baseboards throughout the home.
Clean and treat wood floors appropriate to their finish, plus vacuum and spot-clean any area rugs.
Degrease kitchen surfaces including counters, stovetop, and original tile backsplash, and clean inside the microwave.
Scrub bathroom tile, grout, fixtures, and mirrors, paying extra attention to older grout that holds buildup.
Wipe down built-in cabinetry, window seats, and other Craftsman or Spanish-revival architectural details.
diyOrPro: Routine dusting and light surface cleaning is fine to handle yourself. A full deep clean of original wood floors, decorative tile, or built-in woodwork is worth hiring a pro for, since the wrong cleaning product can dull or damage period finishes that are hard to replace.
priceNote: This job runs $200 to $365, based on a $56/hour rate and jobs typically taking 3 to 6 hours. Where you land in that range depends mostly on the size of the home, the number of bathrooms, and how much detailed cleaning the original tile, wood floors, and built-ins need.

faqs.q: Will the cleaner use products safe for original hardwood floors and tile?
faqs.a: Pros working through Tarea use standard cleaning products suited to the surface, but it's worth mentioning any older or delicate finishes when you book so they can adjust as needed.

faqs.q: Does deep cleaning include the inside of cabinets or closets?
faqs.a: Standard deep cleaning covers visible surfaces, floors, and fixtures. If you want cabinet interiors or closets included, mention it when booking so it's factored into the time and price.

faqs.q: How long will a deep clean take for a typical Pasadena bungalow?
faqs.a: Most jobs take 3 to 6 hours depending on the size of the home and how much buildup there is, particularly in kitchens and bathrooms with older tile.
